biography: Keith Sinclair, a name whispered with both promise and frustration in the British racing paddock, hails from a small, unassuming village in the Cotswolds. His journey began not on the asphalt, but on the muddy fields behind his family's farm, where he'd tear around on a battered quad bike, honing his reflexes and a daredevil spirit. A pivotal moment came during a local hill climb; despite driving an underpowered, borrowed Ginetta G40, Sinclair stunned the crowd with a series of breathtakingly aggressive runs, earning him the attention of a local racing team owner. He showed amazing speed in the car, however a nasty crash at Brands Hatch almost ruined the young man's career. Sinclair's inconsistency is his biggest enemy. One race he'll deliver a podium finish, the next he'll be struggling to stay in the points. He currently races in the Ginetta GT Championship, seeking the consistency needed to make the jump to bigger leagues.
drivingStyle: Sinclair is an inherently aggressive driver, bordering on reckless. He thrives on late braking and daring overtakes, often pushing the limits of his car and his rivals. His tire management is questionable, often burning through his rubber in the early stages of a race, leaving him vulnerable in the closing laps. Under pressure, Sinclair can either rise to the occasion with a moment of brilliance or crack completely, making unforced errors that cost him valuable points.
rivalries: Marcus Thorne: A long-standing rivalry stemming from a controversial collision at Silverstone that cost Sinclair a championship.
Isabelle Rossi: A fierce on-track competitor known for her calculated driving style, often clashing with Sinclair's aggressive maneuvers.
James Faulkner: The son of a racing legend who Sinclair accused of gaining an unfair advantage through team politics.
quirks: Always wears the same lucky pair of socks, even if they are full of holes.
Listens to classical music on full blast in the garage before every race to 'calm the nerves'.
Refuses to eat anything green on race day, believing it brings bad luck.
famousQuote: "Sometimes you gotta send it, even if it means kissing the wall a little. That's racing, innit?"
careerHighlight: Winning the Ginetta Junior Championship in 2018, showcasing his raw talent and potential to the racing world.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead on the final lap of the 2021 Ginetta GT Championship race at Brands Hatch, costing him a potential title.
